english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for casually greeting or addressing someone.
Use this for the ordinary greeting or salutation sense rather than merely calling out to get someone's attention.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 daa2 ziu1 fu1

examples.english: We stopped to hail our old teacher.
examples.traditional: 我哋見到以前個老師，停低同佢打招呼。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gin3 dou2 ji5 cin4 go3 lou5 si1 ting4 dai1 tung4 keoi5 daa2 ziu1 fu1
